Description: Caster is aware of the presence of all sentient/thinking beings within his range.
Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described in detail.
Caster stores mental pattern of target. This information can be used later to recognize the target or locate the target through Finding.
Caster gets direction and distance to any one unshielded Mind Stored target within range.
Caster learns the race, the profession, and the level of target.
Caster gets direction to any unshielded Mind Stored target within range.
As Presence, plus a general knowledge of the actions of each being (e.g., being is casting a spell, but not what spell is being cast).
As Finding, but both the caster and target must be outdoors while stars are visible.
As Location, except range is 20 miles.
As Direction, except no range limitations.
As Finding, except no range limitations.

As Finding True, except Caster can 'track' target for the next 24 hours without further power point expenditure (though he must concentrate. He simply needs to concentrate for a round to determine current distance and direction).
